key.name: activation-method
key.description: How to activate the spotlight: shake, always

key.name: find-my-mouse-activation
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that activates the spotlight

key.name: shake-interval
key.description: Deprecated: retained only so existing user settings remain valid

key.name: shake-sensitivity
key.description: Deprecated: retained only so existing user settings remain valid

key.name: gesture-reversals
key.summary: Direction changes required for the mouse gesture
key.description: Number of horizontal direction changes before the gesture can be confirmed by stopping

key.name: gesture-sweep
key.summary: Minimum travel per sweep in pixels
key.description: Each direction change must cover at least this distance to count

key.name: gesture-window
key.summary: Mouse gesture time window in milliseconds
key.description: Maximum time allowed to perform all direction changes

key.name: gesture-settle
key.summary: Settle time after the final direction change
key.description: Milliseconds allowed for the pointer to slow down after the last direction change

key.name: gesture-cooldown
key.description: Further gestures are ignored for this long after an activation

key.name: gesture-ignore-buttons
key.summary: Ignore gestures while a mouse button is held
key.description: Prevents drags and window moves from activating the spotlight

key.name: gesture-ignore-fullscreen
key.description: Prevents gaming and presentations from activating the spotlight

key.name: gesture-sound
key.summary: Play a sound on gesture activation
key.description: Opt-in confirmation sound; silent by default

key.name: do-not-activate-gamemode
key.summary: Do not activate in Game Mode
key.description: Prevents spotlight when Game Mode is on

key.name: background-color
key.description: Color of the spotlight backdrop with alpha (PowerToys default: #00000080 = black 50%)

key.name: spotlight-color
key.description: Color of the ring at the edge of the spotlight area. The default is 80% opaque white to keep a 3:1 contrast ratio on light desktops.

key.name: spotlight-radius
key.description: Radius of the circle in pixels (PowerToys default: 100)

key.name: spotlight-zoom
key.description: Initial zoom factor for animation - starts big and shrinks (PowerToys default: 9x)

key.name: idle-timeout
key.description: Time in ms to wait after mouse stops moving before hiding spotlight (PowerToys default: 1000)

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration of fade-out animation in ms (PowerToys default: 500)

key.name: log-level
key.description: Maximum log level to display (0=Error, 1=Warn, 2=Info, 3=Debug)

key.name: show-on-all-monitors
key.description: When enabled, the spotlight will cover all monitors instead of just the current one

key.name: spotlight-ring-width
key.description: Width of the spotlight ring border in pixels
